name: skip-link
description: "Skip to content" link: the page's first tab stop, visually hidden until it takes focus, then pinned to the top-start corner above everything else

href.description: Fragment link to the page's main content: the id of its <main> (required)

text.description: Link text, read by screen readers at every moment and shown on focus

required_attrs: href pointing at the id of the page's <main> (or its first content landmark)
visible link text that says where it goes ("Skip to content")

keyboard.Tab: The first Tab on the page focuses the link and reveals it
keyboard.Enter: Follows the link: focus and scroll move to the main content

a11y.notes: Put it first in <body> (or first inside the site-header root), so it is the first tab stop, and give the <main> it targets an id. It is hidden with the same clip as data-ui="visually-hidden", so it is never removed from the accessibility tree, and it is revealed on :focus (not only :focus-visible) so a focused link is never invisible. Nothing animates, so there is no motion to reduce. Use one per page; a page with a long navigation block may add a second that skips that block.
